activity.notes: Cheddi Jagan was declared elected and sworn in as President of Guyana on 9 October 1992. His presidency ended with his death on 6 March 1997. The user-supplied 'Guyanese Empire' label is rejected; the historical polity was the Co-operative Republic of Guyana.

sources.title: Parliament of Guyana — Sixth Parliament, 1992–1997
sources.citation_text: The official parliamentary history states that Jagan was declared elected and sworn in as President on 9 October 1992.

sources.title: Parliament of Guyana — 94th Sitting minutes
sources.citation_text: The National Assembly minutes record the death of President Cheddi Jagan on 6 March 1997 and the assumption of office by Prime Minister Samuel Hinds.
